title: Update About EpicBypassed
features:

Overall, because of the technical issues, I am going to back down on EpicBypassed for now. Considering CatBypasser is gonna launch they're update soon, there's no reason making a bypasser. Powered by Luna (Discord.gg/getluna), inspired by CatBypasser (Discord.gg/catbyp). Have a good day, and hope to see this script back to business soon!
